title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
title_zh: Harvest Evolution Hits a Ceiling: 当重量训练应该开始时，框架演化达到上限

paragraphs.en: Improving a long-horizon LLM agent means evolving the harness around a frozen model or training its weights. We follow one line through both: let a self-evolving harness make the system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. We show that the right lever can be read off the agent’s failure composition. Labelling failed trajectories by the first signal that fires separates process failures (blocked calls, loops, exhausted step budgets) from content failures (a delivered plan that is poor). Harness evolution repairs the former, the behaviour it instils can be trained into the weights, and content failures are what weight training is for. On DeepPlanning, a verifiable planning benchmark with a held-out split, a self-evolving harness loop, in which an LLM proposes edits to its own harness and a judge verifies them, lifts the held-out score of Qwen3.5-4B from 0.16 to 0.30 and of Qwen3.5-9B from 0.32 to 0.44, and the gain lands where the claim places it: for 4B, held-out delivery rises from 55% to 90% and loops fall, while content failures are left for the weights. Ablations pin the gain on capability-granting components rather than on enforcement, and the loop’s own evidence package shows why it stops where it does. LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories then internalise the gain: under the original harness they add +0.13 on held-out tasks for both sizes; on 4B they stack with the harness to more than double the held-out score, and on 9B the adapter alone matches the full evolution line, cutting content failures from a quarter of trajectories to one in twenty. A placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls below the base model, so the gain is in the trajectory content; full fine-tuning on a larger trajectory set adds a further +0.04. The same loop transfers to WebArena-Lite (+0.09 on 117 unseen tasks), where its gain lives in what the model sees, two pages of history instead of one, and adapters trained on those trajectories do not add to it. The result is a diagnose-then-intervene rule applied twice: read the failure composition, and evolve the harness for process failures and train the weights for content failures; then read what the accepted edits changed, and train in the gains that changed what the model writes while keeping the harness for the gains that changed what it sees.
paragraphs.zh: 改进长时程 LLM 智能体，意味着演进围绕一个固定模型的工具层，或者训练其权重。 我们在两者中都遵循同一条路径：首先让一个自我演进的工具层使系统更强，然后交叉组合原始种子工具层与演进后的工具层、基础模型与训练后的权重，以学习训练后的模型保留了哪些增益，哪些仍需运行时支持。 我们证明，正确的调节杠杆可以从智能体的失败构成中直接读取。 根据首次触发的信号对失败的轨迹进行标记，可以将流程失败（被阻塞的调用、循环、步骤预算耗尽）与内容失败（生成的计划质量差）区分开来。 工具层的演进可以修复前者，其植入的行为可以被训练到权重中，而内容失败正是权重训练所要解决的问题。 在 DeepPlanning 上——一个具有预留测试集的可用验证规划基准——一个自我演进的工具层循环（其中 LLM 提出对自身工具层的修改，并由评判者进行验证），将 Qwen3.5-4B 的预留测试得分从 0.16 提升至 0.30，Qwen3.5-9B 的得分从 0.32 提升至 0.44；增益也如预期般分布：对于 4B 模型，预留测试中的任务完成率从 55% 升至 90%，循环次数减少，而内容失败则留待权重训练解决。 消融实验表明，该增益源于赋予能力的组件，而非执行机制；循环本身的证据包也解释了其为何会在特定位置停止。 在演进后工具层轨迹上训练的 LoRA 适配器随后将这一增益内化：在原始工具层下，两种规模的模型在预留测试任务上的得分均增加了 +0.13；对于 4B 模型，适配器与工具层叠加后使预留测试得分翻倍以上，而对于 9B 模型，仅靠适配器就达到了完整演进线的水平，并将内容失败从轨迹的四分之一降至二十分之一。 在答案顺序被打乱的轨迹上训练的安慰剂适配器表现低于基础模型，因此增益确实来自轨迹内容；在更大轨迹集上进行完整微调则额外增加了 +0.04。 同样的循环也迁移到了 WebArena-Lite（在 117 个未见过的任务上提升了 +0.09），其增益体现在模型所见信息的变化上——即从单页历史变为两页历史，而基于这些轨迹训练的适配器并未进一步增加该得分。 最终结果是一个“先诊断、再干预”的规则被两次应用：首先读取失败构成，针对流程失败演进工具层，针对内容失败训练权重；然后读取被接受的修改带来了哪些变化，并针对改变了模型输出内容的增益训练权重，同时保留那些改变了模型所见信息的增益所依赖的工具层。

paragraphs.en: A long-horizon LLM agent can be improved in two places. One can change the harness , the code and text around a frozen model: system prompts, memory tools, checkpoints, output gates, the tools it may call. Or one can change the weights , by fine-tuning on trajectories. Each lever has its own literature, self-evolving harnesses ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) and trajectory fine-tuning ( Zeng et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Qi et al., 2024 ) , and concurrent work has begun to alternate the two ( Kim et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . A self-evolving harness can raise the system’s score without touching the weights, but that score does not say whether the model still needs the runtime to reach it. Our line is therefore: let self-evolution make the harnessed system stronger first, then cross seed and evolved harnesses with base and trained weights to learn which gains the trained model keeps and which still need the runtime. Both levers are expensive to evaluate and the per-rollout score is noisy, so the rule for which lever to pull must be grounded in measurements that survive the noise.
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划的大型语言模型智能体可以在两个方面进行改进。 一方面，可以改变“约束框架”，即围绕一个固定模型运行的代码和文本：系统提示、记忆工具、检查点、输出门控以及模型可能调用的工具。 另一方面，也可以通过在轨迹上进行微调来改变模型权重。 每种方法都有各自的相关文献：自我演化的约束框架（Lin et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2024；Xia et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026a）和轨迹微调（Zeng et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2023；Qi et al., 2024），同时已有研究开始将这两种方法交替使用（Kim et al., 2026a；Chen et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026）。 自我演化的约束框架可以在不修改模型权重的情况下提升系统的得分，但该得分并未说明模型是否仍需运行时环境才能达到该分数。 因此，我们的研究路线是：首先让自我演化使受约束的系统更强，然后将基础模型和训练后的模型与原始种子模型及演化后的约束框架进行交叉结合，以了解训练后的模型保留了哪些提升，而哪些提升仍需要运行时环境的支持。 这两种方法都难以评估，且每次推理的得分存在噪声，因此决定采用哪种方法的规则必须基于能够过滤噪声的测量指标。

paragraphs.en: This paper builds that rule empirically on DeepPlanning ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , a travel-planning benchmark with deterministic programmatic scoring, using 48 development tasks for every decision and 72 held-out tasks no loop ever saw. We first fix the measurement protocol: with a per-rollout standard deviation of 0.023, every configuration is a four-rollout mean, differences below 0.035 are noise, and a fresh anchor follows every accepted change. We then label every trajectory by the first failure signal that fires (Section 3.1 ): unbacked assertions in the plan (F1), the harness’s own interventions getting in the way (F2), loops and exhausted step budgets (F3), or a delivered plan that is simply poor (F4). The hypothesis the paper tests is that the harness lever removes the process classes (F2, F3) and leaves the content class (F4) in place, that the behaviour the harness instils can be trained into the weights, and that the content class is the target for weight training (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本文基于 DeepPlanning（Zhang 等人，2026b）这一旅行规划基准，通过经验方法构建该规则；该基准具有确定性的程序化评分机制，每个决策使用 48 个开发任务，另有 72 个任务被保留且从未被任何循环处理过。 我们首先明确测量协议：每次展开的标准差为 0.023，每种配置均为四次展开的平均值，差异低于 0.035 的部分视为噪声，每次被接受的变更之后都会引入一个新的基准。 接着，我们通过首次触发的失败信号对每条轨迹进行标记（第 3.1 节）：计划中缺乏依据的断言（F1）、测试框架自身的干预造成阻碍（F2）、循环和步骤预算耗尽（F3），或最终生成的计划本身质量低下（F4）。 本文检验的假设是：测试框架杠杆能够移除过程类（F2、F3），但保留内容类（F4）；测试框架所植入的行为可以被训练到权重中；而内容类正是权重训练的目标（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Why the loop stops at F4. Component ablations (Section 6 ) show that the compliance-enforcing components (exit gate, checkpoint, hard blocks) are mostly within noise, whereas the capability-granting components (a state ledger, a distilled lessons file, invented tools) carry the gain. Yet the evidence package the proposal model reads leads with gate and checkpoint metrics and never aggregates the scorer’s failure composition: the loop optimises what it can see, and what it can see does not include the cause of F4.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么循环在 F4 处停止。 组件消融分析（第 6 节）表明，合规执行组件（退出门、检查点、硬性限制）大多处于噪声范围内，而能力赋予组件（状态账本、提炼后的经验文件、虚构工具）则带来了增益。 然而，提案模型读取的证据包仅关注门和检查点的指标，从未汇总评分器的失败构成：循环只会优化它能看到的部分，而它能看到的部分并不包含 F4 的原因。

paragraphs.en: Weight training (LoRA on trajectories collected under the evolved harness, Section 5 ) transfers to held-out tasks: on the seed harness the adapter alone adds +0.13 for both sizes, matching or exceeding what harness evolution delivered; stacked on the evolved harness it adds a further +0.04 / +0.08 (dev / held-out) for 4B, while for 9B the adapter alone reaches the evolved-harness level, so at that size the two levers substitute for each other. Each adapter moves its own failure class (the 4B adapter raises delivery and cuts loops, the 9B adapter cuts F4 from 23–28% of trajectories to 5–7%); a placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories falls 0.16 / 0.23 below the base model, and full fine-tuning adds about +0.04 on held-out over LoRA.

paragraphs.en: Contributions. (1) A measurement protocol for harness and weight interventions on a noisy long-horizon benchmark, with a bound on selection optimism. (2) Harness self-evolution on two model sizes with held-out validation, decomposed into delivery, loop reduction and plan quality; F4 is the class the loop left in place in both Qwen lines. (3) Component ablations on both sizes: capability-granting components carry the gain, enforcement mostly does not. (4) An account of why the loop stops at F4, from what its evidence package shows the proposer. (5) LoRA and full-parameter training on evolved-harness trajectories, with a placebo control and a rank ablation: the gain transfers to held-out tasks, stacks with the harness on 4B and substitutes for it on 9B, and each adapter moves the failure class the rule assigns to it; on WebArena-Lite, where the gain lives in what the model sees, it did not train in. (6) Generality: across nine evolution lines on eight models from six families, the seed measurements separate the five lines where the harness lever paid (+0.05 to +0.14) from the three where it paid nothing; the loop transfers to a second benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 (1) 一项针对嘈杂长周期基准测试中 harness 和 weight 干预的测量协议，并给出了选择乐观性的界限。 (2) 在两个模型规模上对 harness 的自我演化进行测量，并使用预留验证集，结果分解为交付、循环削减和计划质量；F4 是循环在两条 Qwen 线路中保留的类别。 (3) 在两种模型规模上的组件消融实验：赋予能力的组件带来了增益，而约束机制则基本没有贡献。 (4) 对循环为何在 F4 处停止的解释，基于其证据包向提议者展示的内容。 (5) 在演化 harness 轨迹上进行 LoRA 和全参数训练，并设置安慰剂对照和秩消融实验：该增益可迁移到预留任务中，在 4B 模型上与 harness 叠加，在 9B 模型上则替代了它；每个适配器都会改变规则为其指定的失败类别；在 WebArena-Lite 上，由于增益存在于模型所见的内容中，而训练时并未涉及这些内容。 (6) 普适性：在六个模型家族中的八个模型上进行的九条演化线路中，初始测量结果将 harness 杠杆产生收益的五条线路（+0.05 至 +0.14）与三条无收益的线路区分开来；该循环还可迁移到第二个基准测试中。

paragraphs.en: Taxonomies of agent failure have grown fine-grained: MAST ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) annotates fourteen failure modes of multi-agent systems, TRAIL ( Deshpande et al., 2025 ) and AgentErrorTaxonomy ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) label reasoning, execution and planning errors inside traces, and Rahman et al. (2026) catalogue 78 failure types. These are organised by the kind of error and need an LLM or a human annotator; ours is organised by the lever that removes the error and is computed by a deterministic checker from process signals and the scorer. Ecdysis ( Yue et al., 2026 ) comes closest, using recurrence across tasks to decide which failures the harness should absorb; we test the split by applying each lever and reading which class it moves.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体失效的分类体系已变得愈发精细：MAST（Cemri 等，2025）标注了多智能体系统的十四种失效模式，TRAIL（Deshpande 等，2025）和 AgentErrorTaxonomy（Zhu 等，2025）则在轨迹中标注推理、执行和规划错误，而 Rahman 等 （2026）则列出了 78 种失效类型。 这些分类按错误类型进行组织，并需要 LLM 或人工标注者；而我们的分类则按消除错误的机制进行组织，并由确定性检查器根据进程信号和评分器计算得出。 Ecdysis（Yue 等，2026）最为接近，它通过跨任务的重复性来判断哪些失效应由框架吸收；我们通过应用每种机制并观察其将错误移至哪个类别来检验这种划分。

paragraphs.en: Fine-tuning agents on trajectories has a settled recipe: AgentTuning ( Zeng et al., 2023 ) and FireAct ( Chen et al., 2023 ) distil GPT-4 trajectories into small models, WebRL ( Qi et al., 2024 ) trains web agents on WebArena-Lite with an online curriculum, and STaR-style self-improvement ( Zelikman et al., 2022 ) trains on the model’s own filtered outputs, the recipe we use; Yu et al. (2024) moved a prompting scaffold’s gain into the weights for single-turn tasks. Concurrent work brings the question to agent harnesses: Harness-Zero ( Ye et al., 2026 ) distils an optimised harness into the weights and removes it at deployment, Co-Harness ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and WHALE ( Kim et al., 2026a ) alternate harness search and weight updates, Kim et al. (2026b) show that harness-aware post-training is more robust to tool shift, and Yu et al. (2026) find that imitating an expert under an evolved harness can regress. These works switch lever by schedule or by training signal; we switch on the failure composition, obtain the removable-harness result with plain fine-tuning on the model’s own trajectories, show that it is size-dependent, and add a placebo adapter trained on answer-shuffled trajectories. LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) and QLoRA ( Dettmers et al., 2023 ) supply the machinery; long-horizon RL credit assignment ( Schulman et al., 2017 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) is the route we do not take.
paragraphs.zh: 在轨迹上对智能体进行微调已有成熟的方案：AgentTuning（Zeng 等人，2023）和 FireAct（Chen 等人，2023）将 GPT-4 的轨迹蒸馏到小型模型中，WebRL（Qi 等人，2024）在 WebArena-Lite 上利用在线课程训练网络智能体，而 STaR 风格的自我改进方法（Zelikman 等人，2022）则使用模型自身经过筛选的输出进行训练，这也是我们所采用的方案；Yu 等人 （2024）将提示框架带来的增益整合到了单轮任务的模型权重中。 同步进行的研究引发了关于智能体框架的问题：Harness-Zero（Ye 等人，2026）将优化后的框架蒸馏到模型权重中，并在部署时将其移除；Co-Harness（Chen 等人，2026）和 WHALE（Kim 等人，2026a）则在框架搜索与权重更新之间交替进行；Kim 等人 （2026b）指出，具备框架意识的后训练方法对工具变更更具鲁棒性，而 Yu 等人 （2026）发现，在演化后的框架下模仿专家模型可能会导致性能退化。 这些研究通过调整计划或训练信号来切换策略；我们则根据失败构成进行切换，通过对模型自身轨迹进行普通微调获得了可移除框架的结果，证明了该效果与模型规模相关，并添加了一个在答案顺序打乱的轨迹上训练的安慰剂适配器。 LoRA（Hu 等人，2022）和 QLoRA（Dettmers 等人，2023）提供了实现机制；而长时程强化学习的信用分配方法（Schulman 等人，2017；Shao 等人，2024；Yan 等人，2026；Tan 等人，2026）则是我们未采用的路径。

paragraphs.en: What this paper adds. Relative to these lines, this paper (i) labels failures by the lever that removes them and shows, by applying both levers, where the split holds; (ii) measures both levers on the same models and tasks under one calibrated noise model; (iii) traces the harness ceiling to what the loop’s evidence package shows the proposer; and (iv) turns the results into a rule that reads the lever off the failure composition.
paragraphs.zh: 本文的贡献。 相对于这些研究，本文（i）通过移除失败的杠杆来标注失败，并通过同时应用两种杠杆来展示分歧点；（ii）在同一模型和任务上，基于一个校准过的噪声模型测量这两种杠杆；（iii）将约束上限追溯至循环证据包向提议者展示的内容；以及（iv）将这些结果转化为一条规则，该规则可根据失败构成直接读出所用杠杆。

paragraphs.en: Each trajectory is labelled post hoc by an automated checker: a trajectory whose delivered plan scores at least 0.5 is healthy , and every other trajectory receives the first of the following signals that fires:
paragraphs.zh: 每条轨迹都由一个自动检查器进行事后标记：如果所交付计划的得分至少为 0.5，则该轨迹被视为“健康”；所有其他轨迹则会接收到以下信号中第一个被触发的信号：

paragraphs.en: F1, evidence : at least half of the plan’s factual claims are unbacked by anything retrieved (unbacked-citation ratio ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ), or the agent passed the exit gate with unresolved items.
paragraphs.zh: F1，证据：计划中至少一半的事实性主张没有通过检索到的任何内容得到支持（无依据引用比率 ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5），或者智能体在未解决项目未完成的情况下通过了出口门。

paragraphs.en: F2, harness friction : a harness intervention itself blocked the agent (a forced checkpoint unlock, or ten or more blocked tool calls) and the score is low.
paragraphs.zh: F2，利用摩擦：一次束缚干预本身阻碍了智能体（强制检查点解锁，或十次或更多被阻止的工具调用），且得分较低。

paragraphs.en: F3, execution control : the same tool call repeated three or more times, or the trajectory used 90% or more of its step budget, or the harness terminated it.
paragraphs.zh: F3，执行控制：同一工具调用重复三次或更多次，或轨迹使用了其步骤预算的90%或以上，或执行框架终止了该过程。

paragraphs.en: F4, planning capacity : none of the signals above fired; in practice a plan was delivered and scores below 0.5 (rarely, an undelivered trajectory with no process signal).
paragraphs.zh: F4，规划能力：上述信号均未触发；实际上，一个计划被交付，且分数低于 0.5（罕见情况下，会出现无过程信号的未交付轨迹）。

paragraphs.en: Separately, we record the delivery rate , the fraction of trajectories that returned a parsable plan at all, and the quality among delivered plans , the mean score over those trajectories; the composite score is their product. This is the hypothesis the paper tests: F2 and F3 are the classes a harness can act on directly, and F4 is the class it did not reach in either Qwen line, since by construction nothing in the trajectory’s process signals distinguishes an F4 trajectory from a healthy one; a harness gain that consists of removed F2 and F3 trajectories is a behaviour, which the weights can learn. Table 6 (Appendix D ) gives the composition before and after evolution for both Qwen sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们分别记录了交付率（即至少返回一个可解析计划的轨迹所占比例），以及已交付计划的质量（即这些轨迹的平均得分）；综合得分是两者的乘积。 这是本文所检验的假设：F2 和 F3 是执行器可以直接作用的类别，而 F4 是它在两种 Qwen 线路中均未达到的类别，因为根据构造，轨迹处理过程中没有任何信号能将 F4 轨迹与健康轨迹区分开来；由移除的 F2 和 F3 轨迹组成的执行器增益是一种行为，权重可以对此进行学习。 表 6（附录 D）给出了两种 Qwen 规模在演化前后各自的组成情况。

paragraphs.en: DeepPlanning ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) poses multi-day travel-planning tasks that require tool calls (flights, hotels, attractions, distances), state tracking across many steps, and a final structured plan that is scored programmatically against hard constraints. We use 120 tasks split once, before any experiment, into 48 development tasks and 72 held-out tasks. All evolution, training and ablation decisions use only the 48 development tasks; the 72 held-out tasks are evaluated only for reporting. The official benchmark loop is replaced by our own harness that exposes state to the agent and logs every step; the official tools and scorer are unchanged. Our primary models are Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, served locally with thinking disabled at temperature 0.7. Three further families (MiniCPM5-2B, Spark-X2.5-4B, Ministral-3-8B) and Gemma 4 12B test the other branch of the rule (Appendix H ).

paragraphs.en: Every configuration is scored as the mean of four rollouts. Across 26 same-night cells the per-rollout standard deviation has median 0.023 (worst 0.042; Appendix A ), so we treat a difference between two 4-rollout means as resolvable only above 0.035 and write “within noise” below it; comparisons are made between cells run on the same machine on the same night, since cross-night drift of one configuration reaches 0.05; the exceptions are marked where they occur and listed under Limitations.

paragraphs.en: We run a self-evolving loop in the style of AHE ( Lin et al., 2026 ) : an LLM reads the evidence from the current harness’s own runs and rewrites the harness. One round: (1) run the current harness on the 48 development tasks (4 rollouts); (2) an evidence package is built from the run (score, healthy rate, F1–F4 counts, process metrics, worst cases) and handed to a proposal model (Kimi K3), which returns two candidate edits, each with a manifest and its own rollback condition; (3) each candidate is evaluated with 4 rollouts and judged against the round’s anchor by fixed house rules (reject if the mean drops by more than 0.02, if the healthy rate drops by 0.05, or if the no-submission or repeat-call rate rises by 0.05) plus the proposer’s own rollback condition; (4) the better accepted candidate is retained, and a fresh 4-rollout anchor of the new harness is measured before the next round. The editable surface is the harness definition only: prompt files, policy parameters, middleware and tools. Each line starts from the same seed harness (a state ledger, an exit gate, a mid-trajectory checkpoint and four hard blocks). The 4B line ran 13 rounds (26 candidates) and the 9B line 5 rounds (10 candidates); full logs are in Appendices B and C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们运行了一个类似 AHE（Lin et al., 2026）的自我演化循环：一个大语言模型读取当前 harness 自身运行产生的证据，并重新编写该 harness。 一轮流程如下：(1) 在 48 个开发任务上运行当前的 harness（共 4 次 rollout）；(2) 从运行结果中构建一个证据包（包括分数、健康率、F1–F4 计数、流程指标和最差情况），并将其交给一个提案模型（Kimi K3），该模型返回两个候选编辑，每个编辑都包含一个清单和自身的回滚条件；(3) 每个候选项通过 4 次 rollout 进行评估，并依据固定的内部规则与本轮的基准进行比较（若平均值下降超过 0.02、健康率下降 0.05，或无提交或重复调用率上升 0.05，则予以拒绝），同时结合提案者自身的回滚条件进行判断；(4) 保留表现更优且被接受的候选项，并在下一轮开始前测量新 harness 的新一轮 4 次 rollout 基准。 可编辑的部分仅限于 harness 定义：提示文件、策略参数、中间件和工具。 每一行都从相同的初始 harness（一个状态账本、一个退出门、一个中途检查点和四个硬性模块）开始。 4B 行运行了 13 轮（26 个候选项），而 9B 行运行了 5 轮（10 个候选项）；完整日志见附录 B 和 C。

paragraphs.en: Where does the gain come from? Table 7 (Appendix D ) splits each score into delivery rate and quality among delivered plans, and Table 6 gives the failure composition. For 4B, delivery rises from 59% to 88% and loop failures (F3) fall from 64% to 37% of trajectories; Equation 2 assigns 0.077 of the +0.136 to delivery and 0.058 to the higher mean among delivered plans (0.266 to 0.332), and a paired comparison between the bare model and the full evolved harness on the tasks both deliver (Appendix F ) moves by only +0.011 on dev and +0.022 on held-out, consistent with the higher mean reflecting which plans are now delivered rather than better plans on the same tasks. For 9B, delivery was already 97% and the gain is a better plan among delivered ones (0.309 to 0.392), the r ′ ​ Δ ​ q ¯ r^{\prime}\,\Delta\bar{q} term, with loops falling from 39% to 17%. In neither line did the loop reduce F4: it grows from 10% to 28% of 4B trajectories as loops are converted and stays at 25% for 9B, where it is the largest failure class at the end; for 4B the residual F3 (37%) is still larger (Figure 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这种提升来自哪里？ 表 7（附录 D）将每个得分细分为已交付方案中的交付率和质量，而表 6 则给出了失败构成的具体情况。 对于 4B，交付率从 59% 提升至 88%，循环失败（F3）在轨迹中的占比则从 64% 降至 37%；方程 2 将 +0.136 的提升中 0.077 归因于交付率的提高，0.058 归因于已交付方案中均值的提升（从 0.266 到 0.332）；而在基础模型与完整演化框架在共同交付任务上的配对比较中（附录 F），开发集上的提升仅为 +0.011，验证集上为 +0.022，这与“更高均值”反映的是哪些方案现在被成功交付，而非同一任务上方案质量有所改善的情况一致。 对于 9B，交付率已达到 97%，因此提升源于已交付方案中更优的方案（从 0.309 到 0.392），即 r′​Δ​q¯ 项，同时循环失败的比例从 39% 降至 17%。 在这两种情况下，循环均未减少 F4：在 4B 的轨迹中，随着循环被转换，F4 的比例从 10% 增至 28%；而在 9B 中则保持在 25%，此时它已成为最终的失败类别中占比最大的类型；对于 4B，剩余的 F3（37%）仍然更高（图 3）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 (plotted as Figure 5 in Appendix E ) reports the same-night evaluation of the LoRA adapters trained on evolved-harness trajectories (Section 4.3 ). Four findings. (i) The adapter transfers. On the seed harness, the better adapter lifts held-out scores by +0.126 (4B, qkvo) and +0.131 (9B, qkvo+MLP), and development scores by +0.151 and +0.050; seven of the eight adapter-on-seed-harness cells are positive. (ii) Stacking on 4B, substitution on 9B. On the evolved harness, the 4B adapter still adds +0.041 (dev) and +0.082 (held-out); the 9B adapter adds +0.010 and +0.007, within noise, as is the other 9B adapter. For 9B either lever alone reaches 0.44–0.45 on held-out. (iii) Content, not adapter. The placebo (Table 10 , Appendix E ), trained with the identical recipe on the same trajectories with the assistant outputs permuted across samples, scores 0.158 below the base model on dev and 0.227 below on held-out, and its trajectories run 52–65 rounds instead of 19. Ranks 16, 32 and 64 all gain on held-out (Appendix E ); full-parameter fine-tuning on a larger second textbook beats LoRA by +0.044 (4B) and +0.042 (9B) on held-out. (iv) Each adapter moves its own failure class (Table 9 , Appendix E ). The 4B adapter reproduces the harness’s behavioural effect: delivery rises from 52% to 78% on dev and from 55% to 78% on held-out, loops fall by 18–19 points, and F4 is unchanged. paragraphs.en: Which placement wins follows what the textbook has to teach. The attention-only adapter wins on 4B and the adapter that also trains the MLP blocks wins on 9B (Table 1 ); we select the placement per model on the development split. The 4B textbook was collected by making a model that delivers half of its plans deliver, so what it mostly carries is that behaviour, and the attention-only adapter learned it better (delivery 78% against 67%, F3 40% against 51%; Table 9 ). The 9B textbook comes from a model that already delivers, so it carries plan content, and both adapters cut F4 (from 23% and 28% on dev and held-out), the one that also trains the MLP blocks, where language models hold most of their factual associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ) , by more (to 7% and 5% against 13.5% and 16% for attention only). A richer textbook should then make the MLP placement win on 4B as well, which the second textbook shows (Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 哪种部署方式更优，取决于教科书需要教授的内容。 在 4B 模型上，仅使用注意力机制的适配器表现更优；而在 9B 模型上，同时训练 MLP 模块的适配器表现更优（表 1）；我们根据开发集数据为每个模型选择相应的部署方式。 4B 教科书的构建方式是创建一个能成功执行其一半计划的模型，因此它主要承载了这种行为，而仅使用注意力机制的适配器对此类行为的掌握更好（执行率 78% 对比 67%，F3 准确率为 40% 对比 51%；表 9）。 9B 教科书来自一个本身已具备执行能力的模型，因此它承载了计划内容；两种适配器都降低了 F4 错误率（在开发和预留测试集上分别从 23% 和 28% 降至更低水平），其中同时训练 MLP 模块的适配器降幅更大（降至 7% 和 5%，而仅使用注意力机制的适配器为 13.5% 和 16%）；语言模型的大部分事实性关联都存储于 MLP 模块中（Geva 等，2021）。 因此，一个内容更丰富的教科书应该也能使 4B 模型上采用 MLP 部署方式的方案表现更优，而第二版教科书的结果正证明了这一点（表 8）。

paragraphs.en: WebArena-Lite ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Qi et al., 2024 ) poses 165 web-navigation tasks on five self-hosted sites, with the official environments and scoring; natural-language answers are judged by an LLM. We split it once into 48 development and 117 test tasks and ran the same loop with Qwen3.5-9B under the protocol of Section 4.2 , with a line measured on this benchmark ( σ = 0.045 \sigma=0.045 , line 0.064). The seed harness reproduces the benchmark agent’s interface and adds the ledger, checkpoint and exit gate of the DeepPlanning seed harness. Thirteen rounds accepted ten edits and moved the development anchor from 0.234 to 0.375; one interface edit in round 10, keeping the two most recent full pages in the context instead of one, accounts for +0.12 of it.

paragraphs.en: Where the gain lives decides whether it can go into the weights. LoRA and full-parameter adapters were trained on the 157 full-score trajectories (35 tasks) that the closing harness produced on the development tasks. Measured the night after the base cells (the closing-harness base anchor re-measured alongside them: 0.375 against 0.396), they are within the 0.064 line of the base model on the 117 test tasks under both harnesses (0.344 against 0.327 and 0.331; 0.256 against 0.216 and 0.231); delivery rises further, to 81% and 88%, and accuracy among delivered answers falls, to 0.39 and 0.37. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 collects the nine DeepPlanning evolution lines reported in this paper, ordered by the quality of the plans the seed harness delivers. Three were evolved before the protocol of Section 4.2 , with one rollout per reading: two on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (thinking on and off) and one on Tencent hy3 (thinking on); we re-measured their seed and closing compositions on one night with four rollouts each, and the gains re-measure at +0.063 (Qwen3.6 off), +0.053 (Qwen3.6 on) and +0.065 (hy3), all of it delivery; the Qwen3.6 thinking-on cells are noisier than the Qwen3.5 cells (per-rollout standard deviation up to 0.07), so that gain is within its own noise (Appendix H ). The seed measurements of Section 3.1 , all available before a round is run, separate the nine lines into three groups, and the outcomes follow the grouping. Where the seed harness delivers plans scoring 0.27 or better and F4 is not yet the largest failure class, five lines from a 4B model to hy3, the harness lever paid +0.063 to +0.136 on the development tasks in four and +0.053, within its own noise, in the fifth. paragraphs.en: Appendix F (Tables 11 and 12 ) reports component ablations on both sizes, each set run in one night (the 9B set on two identical machines, cross-machine offset below 0.03), with the line’s closing harness as the full configuration. For 9B, removing the mid-trajectory checkpoint, the exit gate or the four hard blocks leaves the development score within noise of the full harness (+0.019, +0.017, +0.017); removing the evolved lessons file costs 0.049 on dev and 0.076 on held-out, and removing the ledger, together with the controls that depend on it, costs 0.088 and 0.145. The ledger and the lessons are not additive: with neither or with the ledger alone the score is within noise of the bare model; with both it is +0.076 / +0.092 above it. For 4B, removing the loop’s own middleware or its three policy rewrites leaves the score within noise; removing the three invented tools costs 0.071 / 0.090 and removing the lessons file 0.067 / 0.120; removing the exit gate costs nothing on dev but 0.077 on held-out, where delivery drops from 88% to 73%. Tools and lessons account for the largest losses; enforcement is within noise except the 4B exit gate, which holds held-out delivery.

paragraphs.en: The evolution loop can only optimise what it is shown, and what it is shown is the evidence package. Four properties of it bound what the proposer can see. (a) The package leads with intervention process metrics, the components the ablations show do not move the score; the F1–F4 counts come after them, and the scorer’s per-check failure composition was never aggregated into the package. (b) The proposal request is a single call with no tools. (c) The keys that define which metrics are observed live outside the four directories the loop may edit. (d) The accepted edits target what the package makes visible: the 4B tools and prompts raise delivery and cut loops, the 9B lessons cut loops, and no edit changed the rate at which the 9B agent submits several drafts of a plan (25.5% before, 25.0% after), a failure the scorer sees but the package never surfaced. The ceiling is a property of this loop’s evidence package, not of harness evolution in general; a first attempt to surface the failure composition to the proposer (Gemma 4 12B, Appendix H ) did not produce a resolvable gain.
paragraphs.zh: 演化循环只能优化它所看到的内容，而它看到的内容正是证据包。 其四个属性限制了提案者能看到的内容。 (a) 该证据包首先列出干预流程指标，而消融实验显示这些组成部分并不会改变得分；F1–F4 计数排在它们之后，且评分器每次检查的失败构成从未被汇总到证据包中。 (b) 提案请求是一个没有使用任何工具的单一调用。 (c) 定义哪些指标会被观察到的键值位于循环可以编辑的四个目录之外。 (d) 被接受的编辑针对的是证据包所呈现的内容：4B 工具和提示提升了交付效率并缩短了循环，9B 经验教训也缩短了循环，但没有任何编辑改变了 9B 智能体提交多个计划草案的频率（之前为 25.5%，之后为 25.0%）；这一失败情况评分器能看到，但证据包从未呈现出来。 这个上限属于该循环的证据包特性，而非通用演化机制的特性；首次尝试向提案者揭示失败构成（Gemma 4 12B，附录 H）并未带来可解决的改进。

paragraphs.en: A diagnose-then-intervene rule. Measure the noise floor first, then the delivery rate, the quality among delivered plans and the F1–F4 composition on a development set, and branch. (1) Delivered plans score below about 0.18: the harness lever paid nothing on the three such models, moving delivery and F1 while the freed trajectories landed in F4; we did not train them. (2) Delivery well below saturation or F3 dominant: evolve the harness; its gains transferred to held-out tasks in both Qwen lines. (3) Delivery saturated and F4 dominant: train the weights; on 9B the adapter alone was worth as much as the five-round evolution line on held-out, and on 4B the two levers stack. (4) F4 residual after both: the loop as run here cannot see it; expose the scorer’s failure composition to the proposer (Section 6.2 ). (5) A harness gain in hand: read what the accepted edits changed; where they changed what the model does, the adapter carried the gain (Section 5.2 ), and where the gain came from what the model sees, it stayed in the harness (Section 5.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种“先诊断、后干预”的规则。 首先测量噪声底限，然后测量交付率、已交付计划的品质以及开发集上的 F1–F4 构成，再进行分支处理。 (1) 已交付计划的得分低于约 0.18：该框架在这三个模型上未产生任何收益，同时提升了交付效果和 F1，而释放出的轨迹则落入 F4；我们并未对它们进行训练。 (2) 交付效果远低于饱和点或以 F3 为主：进化该框架；其增益在 Qwen 的两条路线中均转移到了预留任务上。 (3) 交付效果已饱和且以 F4 为主：训练权重；在 9B 模型上，仅适配器带来的收益就与五轮进化路线在预留任务上的收益相当，而在 4B 模型上，两种机制的收益可以叠加。 (4) 两者之后仍存在 F4 残余：此处运行的循环无法识别它；将评分器的失败构成暴露给提议者（第 6.2 节）。 (5) 框架增益已明确存在：分析被接受的编辑带来了哪些变化；当这些编辑改变了模型的行为时，增益由适配器承担（第 5.2 节）；而当增益源于模型所见信息的变化时，增益则保留在框架中（第 5.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. Applying the taxonomy needs trajectory-level process signals and a task-level scorer. The 4B ablation cells were run with two rollouts except the exit-gate cell, and the placebo control exists for 9B only. We do not compare the loop with a matched-budget test-time search baseline ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . The benchmark’s plan-to-JSON conversion is an LLM call that inflates scores by about 0.025 on the sample we audited (Appendix I ); every cell uses the same converter. Two comparisons cross nights: the base-model cells under the evolved harness on held-out tasks in Tables 1 and 5 are closing anchors from two nights earlier (two rollouts for 4B, so its held-out stacking gain is read against a 0.05 line), and the WebArena-Lite adapters were measured the night after their base cells (Table 13 ); every other comparison is same-night.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 应用该分类体系需要轨迹级别的流程信号和任务级别的评分器。 除了出口门细胞外，4B 消融细胞均运行了两次展开，而安慰剂对照仅针对 9B 存在。 我们没有将循环结构与预算匹配的测试时搜索基线（Wang et al., 2026b）进行比较。 该基准的“计划转 JSON”转换是一个 LLM 调用，在我们审计的样本中使分数虚增了约 0.025（附录 I）；每个细胞都使用相同的转换器。 有两组比较跨越不同实验夜：表 1 和表 5 中，在保留任务上、基于演化框架运行的基础模型细胞是两天前实验的对照基准（4B 进行了两次展开，因此其保留叠加增益是与 0.05 线对比得出的），而 WebArena-Lite 适配器则是在其基础细胞实验后的当晚进行测量的（表 13）；所有其他比较均在同一实验夜完成。

paragraphs.en: The per-rollout standard deviation was measured on 26 same-night cells from the comparison in Table 1 and its companion adapters (4B and 9B, 48 or 72 tasks, temperature 0.7, four rollouts each): median 0.023, worst 0.042. The range across the four rollouts of a single cell has median 0.055 and reaches 0.094 (a 4B seed-harness cell read 0.171, 0.096, 0.176 and 0.190). Table 2 gives the smallest difference between two cells that we treat as resolvable for a given number of rollouts per cell; the paper uses four rollouts and 0.035 everywhere unless stated. The house rule inside the evolution loop is stricter in one direction: a candidate whose 4-rollout mean falls more than 0.02 below the anchor is rejected, which trades some false rejections for protection against ratchet slippage (Appendix G ). On WebArena-Lite the per-rollout standard deviation is about 0.045, so the resolvable difference at four rollouts is 0.064. Two configurations of the same model evaluated on different nights, even with the serving stack pinned, differed by up to 0.05, which is why comparisons in this paper are same-night unless marked.
paragraphs.zh: 每次展开的标准差基于表1中对比的26个同日晚上的细胞及其配套适配器（4B和9B，48或72个任务，温度0.7，每个细胞四次展开）进行测量：中位数为0.023，最差值为0.042。 单个细胞四次展开结果的跨度中位数为0.055，最大可达0.094（一个4B种子利用细胞的读数为0.171、0.096、0.176和0.190）。 表2给出了对于每个细胞给定次数的展开，我们视为可分辨的两个细胞之间的最小差异；除非另有说明，本文普遍采用四次展开和0.035的标准。 演化循环内的默认规则在某一方向上更为严格：若候选体的四次展开平均值低于锚定值超过0.02，则会被拒绝，这种设置以部分误拒为代价来防止棘轮滑移（附录G）。 在WebArena-Lite上，每次展开的标准差约为0.045，因此在四次展开下可分辨的差异为0.064。 同一模型的两个配置在不同夜晚进行评估时，即使服务器堆栈固定不变，差异也可能高达0.05，因此本文中的比较除非另有标记，否则均为同日晚上的对比。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 lists every candidate with its own reading and the fresh anchor measured after the round. Each round proposed two candidates; 18 of 26 passed the judge, one per round was retained (10 in total) and 8 were rejected, with rounds 4, 5 and 12 rejecting both candidates. The three tool edits (rounds 6, 8, 13) and the lessons file (round 2) are the components that the ablation in Appendix F finds load-bearing. Round 8, a plan-completeness checker tool, is the largest single step (+0.039 on the fresh anchor). One accepted edit turned out to be inert on inspection (the round-3 policy change activated a self-check whose prompt file did not exist) and another silently removed the seed harness’s twenty-call brake on identical calls; the judge cannot distinguish an inert edit from a neutral one, which is one reason we report fresh anchors rather than candidate readings. After round 11 the serving context window was raised from 131k to 262k tokens and the current harness was re-anchored (0.305 to 0.269); the final gain is computed from the re-anchored value.
paragraphs.zh: 表3列出了每个候选方案及其自身的读数，以及该轮结束后测得的新基准值。 每轮提出两个候选方案；26个中有18个通过了评审，每轮保留一个（共10个），另有8个被拒绝，其中第4、5和12轮的两个候选方案均被拒绝。 三种工具编辑（第6、8、13轮）和课程文件（第2轮）是附录F中的消融分析发现具有关键作用的组件。 第8轮使用的计划完整性检查工具是单个步骤中影响最大的（新基准值提升+0.039）。 经检查发现，一个被接受的编辑实际上并无作用（第3轮的政策变更触发了一个自我检查，但其提示文件并不存在）；另一个编辑则在静默状态下移除了种子框架对重复调用施加的二十次调用限制。评审无法区分无作用的编辑与中性的编辑，这也是我们报告新基准值而非候选方案读数的原因之一。 第11轮之后，服务上下文窗口从13.1万提升至26.2万个词元，并对当前框架进行了重新锚定（从0.305变为0.269）；最终增益是基于重新锚定后的数值计算的。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 gives the same record for the 9B line. The 9B line accepted three candidates in five rounds, all of them edits to the distilled lessons file (plan-emission format, hotel-location checks, standalone plan emission); every tool the proposer wrote was rejected because the agent never called it, and the last four candidates read 0.018–0.033 below the anchor and were rejected. The closing harness is therefore the seed harness plus one lessons file, which is why the 9B ablation (Appendix F ) can isolate the whole gain of the line in one cell. An earlier 9B line that we do not report locked its anchor on a single lucky evaluation and then rejected eight consecutive candidates; the fresh-anchor protocol was introduced after it.
paragraphs.zh: 表4给出了9B行的相同记录。 9B行在五轮中接受了三个候选者，它们都是对提炼课程文件（计划-排放格式、酒店位置检查、独立计划排放）的编辑；提案者编写的每个工具都被拒绝了，因为智能体从未调用过它，而最后四个候选者的得分在基准线以下0.018–0.033之间，因此也被拒绝。 因此，最终整合包是初始整合包加上一个课程文件，这就是为什么9B消融分析（附录F）能够在一个单元格中隔离出该行的全部增益。 我们未报告的一个早期9B行将其基准锁定在单次幸运的评估上，随后拒绝了八个连续候选者；新基准协议是在此之后引入的。

paragraphs.en: Both ablations remove components from the closing harness of the corresponding line. paragraphs.en: We document three pitfalls encountered in our own measurement process.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录了自己测量过程中遇到的三个陷阱。

paragraphs.en: Winner’s curse. Selecting the best of K K candidates inflates the selected reading ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . With per-rollout σ ≈ 0.023 \sigma\approx 0.023 and two candidates per round, an accepted candidate’s own reading overstates its effect; in the 4B line the candidate readings at rounds 8, 10 and 11 were 0.316, 0.327 and 0.323 while the fresh anchors of the same harnesses were 0.282, 0.288 and 0.305. We report anchors, never candidate readings; Figure 7 plots every retained candidate’s reading against the fresh anchor of the same harness.
paragraphs.zh: 赢家的诅咒。 从 K 个候选者中选出最佳者会高估所选候选者的读数（Xu 等，2026）。 每次展开的 σ ≈ 0.023，每轮有两个候选者，因此被接受的候选者自身的读数会高估其实际效果；在 4B 线路中，第 8、10 和 11 轮的候选者读数分别为 0.316、0.327 和 0.323，而相同 harness 的新锚点读数则为 0.282、0.288 和 0.305。 我们报告的是锚点读数，而非候选者读数；图 7 将每个保留候选者的读数与相同 harness 的新锚点读数进行了对比。

paragraphs.en: Ratchet slippage. In a sequence of accepts, a lucky round sets the next reference above the true value, and a subsequent neutral edit then reads as a regression and is rejected. Our first 9B line suffered a severe form of this: one outlier accept locked the anchor high and eight consecutive candidates were rejected within noise of it. The mitigation is the fresh anchor: after every accept, the new harness is re-measured before the next candidate is judged.
paragraphs.zh: 棘轮滑移。 在一连串的接受操作中，一次幸运的回合会将下一个参考值设定在真实值之上，随后的一次中性编辑则会被视为倒退而被拒绝。 我们最初的 9B 线路就遭遇了这种问题的严重形式：一个异常值被接受后，将锚点锁定在高处，紧接着八个连续候选项都在其噪声范围内被拒绝。 缓解措施是使用新的锚点：每次接受操作之后，在判断下一个候选项之前，都会重新测量新的约束结构。

paragraphs.en: Inert accepts. An edit that never executes (a middleware wired to the wrong round index, a policy that references a missing file) reads as neutral and can pass the judge, a cousin of the phantom guardrails of Wang et al. (2026a) , which fix failures that never happened. One such edit was accepted in the 4B line and three in the WebArena-Lite line. We now require, before an edit is judged, evidence that its code path fired at least once in the evaluation run.

paragraphs.en: Before finalising the paper we re-measured the seed and closing compositions of all three lines under the full protocol (two runs of two rollouts per cell, temperature 0 as in August). Qwen3.6, thinking off: seed 0.396 (delivery 73%, healthy 44%, F1 10%, F2 32%, F3 9%, F4 5%), closing 0.459 (delivery 91%, healthy 48%, F1 14%, F2 4%, F3 24%, F4 10%), accuracy among delivered plans 0.54 against 0.50: +0.063, all of it delivery, with the harness-friction class F2 removed and the freed trajectories landing mostly in F3. Thinking on: seed 0.266 (delivery 47%, healthy 26%, F1 58%, F3 6%, F4 10%), closing 0.320 (delivery 62%, healthy 29%, F1 46%, F3 12%, F4 13%), accuracy 0.56 against 0.52: +0.053, again delivery, with the evidence class F1 shrinking. All shares use every trajectory as the denominator. The per-rollout standard deviation in these four cells is 0.02–0.07 against 0.023 for Qwen3.5, so the thinking-off gain is resolvable and the thinking-on gain is within the noise of its own cells. hy3: seed 0.690 (delivery 84%, healthy 71%, F1 15%, F2 6%, F3 8%), closing 0.755 (delivery 92%, healthy 80%, F1 8%, F2 5%, F3 6%), accuracy 0.818 against 0.824: +0.065, the blank-submission lesson.
paragraphs.zh: 在最终确定论文之前，我们按照完整方案重新测量了所有三条线路的种子和结束时的组成（每个单元格进行两次运行、每次两次展开，温度设为 0，与八月时相同）。 Qwen3.6，“思考中”状态：种子 0.396（交付率 73%，健康状态 44%，F1 10%，F2 32%，F3 9%，F4 5%），结束状态为 0.459（交付率 91%，健康状态 48%，F1 14%，F2 4%，F3 24%，F4 10%）；已交付计划的准确率为 0.54，对比 0.50：+0.063，全部来自交付率的提升，同时移除了“约束-摩擦”类别 F2，释放出的轨迹主要落入 F3。 “思考中”状态：种子 0.266（交付率 47%，健康状态 26%，F1 58%，F3 6%，F4 10%），结束状态为 0.320（交付率 62%，健康状态 29%，F1 46%，F3 12%，F4 13%）；准确率为 0.56，对比 0.52：+0.053，同样来自交付率的提升，同时“证据”类别 F1 有所缩小。 所有份额均以每条轨迹作为分母进行计算。 在这四个单元格中，每次展开的标准差为 0.02–0.07，而 Qwen3.5 的标准差为 0.023，因此“思考中”状态的增益是可观测的，而“思考中”状态的增益则处于其自身单元格的噪声范围内。hy3：种子 0.690（交付率 84%，健康状态 71%，F1 15%，F2 6%，F3 8%），结束状态为 0.755（交付率 92%，健康状态 80%，F1 8%，F2 5%，F3 6%）；准确率为 0.818，对比 0.824：+0.065，这是“空白提交”带来的经验教训。

paragraphs.en: Three non-Qwen families. The same loop, judge and seed harness were run for five rounds (ten candidates) on MiniCPM5-2B, Spark-X2.5-4B and Ministral-3-8B. The diagnosis step of the rule separates these three from the Qwen lines before any evolution: the healthy share is 0–6% against 15–34% for the Qwen seeds (Table 9 ), the plans that are delivered score 0.13–0.17 against 0.27–0.31 (Table 7 ), and on Spark and Ministral F4 is the largest class at the seed (38% and 65%). All three lines closed within noise of their seed anchor, and the composition says why in each case.
paragraphs.zh: 三个非 Qwen 系列。 在 MiniCPM5-2B、Spark-X2.5-4B 和 Ministral-3-8B 上，相同的循环、判断器和种子机制运行了五轮（十个候选）。 规则的诊断步骤在这些三种模型与 Qwen 系列之间进行了区分，且在任何演化之前就已如此：健康比例分别为 0–6% 和 15–34%（表 9），生成的计划得分分别为 0.13–0.17 和 0.27–0.31（表 7），而在 Spark 和 Ministral 上，F4 在种子阶段是最大的类别（分别为 38% 和 65%）。 这三个系列最终都与其种子锚点处于噪声范围内，而成分分析也说明了每种情况的具体原因。

paragraphs.en: MiniCPM5-2B accepted five of ten candidates and gained delivery (61% to 71%), but the plans it was pushed to deliver score lower than the ones it delivered already (mean among delivered 0.173 to 0.156), so the product did not move; for this model the seed harness itself had been the large gain (0.047 in the official loop to 0.106, more than double).
paragraphs.zh: MiniCPM5-2B 接受了十个候选方案中的五个，并获得了交付（从 61% 提升至 71%），但其被要求交付的方案得分低于其已交付的方案（已交付方案的均分为 0.173，降至 0.156），因此产品并未发生变动；对于该模型而言，种子机制本身才是最大的提升来源（在官方循环中从 0.047 提升至 0.106，增长了一倍多）。

paragraphs.en: Spark-X2.5-4B accepted six candidates that cut F1 from 21% to 7% without moving delivery (97% to 95%) or the score: the freed trajectories landed in F4 (38% to 60%).
paragraphs.zh: Spark-X2.5-4B 接受了六个候选方案，这些方案将 F1 从 21% 降至 7%，但并未改变交付率（97% 至 95%）或得分：释放出的轨迹最终进入了 F4（38% 至 60%）。

paragraphs.en: Ministral-3-8B starts with F2 and F3 at 7% together, so the harness has almost no process failure to act on; five of its ten candidates edited the exit gate, eight of the nine rejections were triggered by the proposer’s own rollback conditions, and the one accept was a syntax fix.
paragraphs.zh: Ministral-3-8B 的 F2 和 F3 初始成功率均为 7%，因此该测试框架几乎没有可处理的流程故障；在其十个候选方案中，有五个修改了退出门，九个拒绝中有八个是由提案者自身的回滚条件触发的，而唯一一次接受则是一个语法修正。

paragraphs.en: On all three the loop’s candidates went where Section 6.2 predicts, to the enforcement layer. These lines ran with the evidence package as it was before the failure composition was added to it; the compositions in Table 14 are computed after the fact from the anchor trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有三种情况下，循环的候选者都按照第 6.2 节的预测，进入了执行层。 这些行在证据包未被添加故障组合之前就已运行；表 14 中的组合是事后根据锚点轨迹计算得出的。

paragraphs.en: Gemma 4 12B. A ten-round line moved the anchor from 0.330 to 0.386, but the anchors were collected across several days on different machines; a same-night re-measurement of seed and evolved harness on the same machine gave +0.019 (dev) and +0.012 (held-out), within noise.
paragraphs.zh: Gemma 4 12B。 一轮十回合的迭代使锚点从 0.330 移动到了 0.386，但这些锚点是在不同日期的不同机器上收集到的；在同一天晚上于同一机器上对初始和演化后的 harness 进行重新测量，结果分别为 +0.019（开发集）和 +0.012（保留集），均在噪声范围内。

paragraphs.en: Training on this line’s trajectories reproduced the ordering of Table 1 at a magnitude within the resolution line: under the seed harness, LoRA gave +0.034 / +0.018 and full-parameter +0.038 / − 0.003 -0.003 (dev / held-out), which puts the trained weights under the seed harness where the base model sits under the evolved harness, and stacking them on the evolved harness added nothing (LoRA − 0.042 -0.042 / − 0.013 -0.013 , full-parameter +0.019 / − 0.040 -0.040 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对该行轨迹的训练再现了表1中的排序，其量级处于分辨率线范围内：在种子框架下，LoRA获得了+0.034 / +0.018，而全参数模型获得了+0.038 / − 0.003 -0.003（开发集 / 保留集），这使得训练后的权重位于种子框架之下，而基础模型则位于演化框架之下；将它们叠加在演化框架上并未带来任何增益（LoRA为− 0.042 -0.042 / − 0.013 -0.013，全参数模型为+0.019 / − 0.040 -0.040）。

paragraphs.en: This model enters with delivery at 98% and F4 the largest class (40% of trajectories), the composition the rule assigns to the weights, so a small harness gain is the branch the rule predicts; the current training recipe, on trajectories from a harness that had barely moved, bought development-task gains that did not carry to held-out, so on this model the weights branch remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型以 98% 的交付率启动，其中 F4 是最大的类别（占轨迹的 40%），其组成由规则分配给权重的规则决定，因此一个微小的 harness 增益就是规则所预测的分支；当前的训练方案基于一个几乎未发生变化的 harness 的轨迹，所带来的开发任务增益并未延续到预留数据上，因此在该模型中，权重分支仍然保持开放。

paragraphs.en: For this loop the evidence package was extended to lead with the scorer’s aggregated failure composition (the change proposed in Section 6.2 ), which is why the Gemma line is the first on which the proposer could see F4-relevant evidence; its gains were nonetheless within noise.
paragraphs.zh: 在此循环中，证据包进行了扩展，以评分者汇总的失败构成为首（即第 6.2 节中提出的变更），因此 Gemma 行是提案者首次能够看到与 F4 相关的证据的行；不过，其增益仍在噪声范围内。

paragraphs.en: WebArena-Lite. Section 5.3 and Table 13 report this line. Two details belong here. Three middleware edits accepted in rounds 1–9 had never executed because of a round-indexing bug in the loop (Appendix G ); with the bug fixed, the closing composition re-anchored from 0.396 to 0.375, within noise, so the line’s gain rests on the interface edits alone. Under the closing harness the undelivered test trajectories stop mostly on the 40-call budget (77 of 108): the closing harness reads more of each page and walks further, which is the observational nature of its gain.
paragraphs.zh: WebArena-Lite。 第 5.3 节和第 13 表报告了这行内容。此处包含两个细节。 在第 1–9 轮中接受的三次中间件修改，由于循环中的轮次索引错误而从未执行（附录 G）；修复该错误后，最终组合的锚定值从 0.396 重新调整为 0.375，处于噪声范围内，因此这行的增益仅取决于接口修改。 在最终测试框架下，未完成的测试轨迹大多在 40 次调用的预算限制内停止（108 次调用中的 77 次）：最终测试框架会读取每个页面的更多内容并执行更远的操作，这正是其增益的观察性本质。

sents.en: Three middleware edits accepted in rounds 1–9 had never executed because of a round-indexing bug in the loop (Appendix G ); with the bug fixed, the closing composition re-anchored from 0.396 to 0.375, within noise, so the line’s gain rests on the interface edits alone.
sents.zh: 在第 1–9 轮中接受的三次中间件修改，由于循环中的轮次索引错误而从未执行（附录 G）；修复该错误后，最终组合的锚定值从 0.396 重新调整为 0.375，处于噪声范围内，因此这行的增益仅取决于接口修改。

sents.en: Under the closing harness the undelivered test trajectories stop mostly on the 40-call budget (77 of 108): the closing harness reads more of each page and walks further, which is the observational nature of its gain.
sents.zh: 在最终测试框架下，未完成的测试轨迹大多在 40 次调用的预算限制内停止（108 次调用中的 77 次）：最终测试框架会读取每个页面的更多内容并执行更远的操作，这正是其增益的观察性本质。

paragraphs.en: DeepPlanning scores a plan only after an LLM converts the agent’s free-text plan into a structured form. We audited this step because our agents often submit several drafts of a plan in one answer (25.0% of the 9B closing harness’s answers, counting the 188 scored answers; 1.0% of the 4B closing harness’s). On 20 such multi-draft answers, four converters (the default qwen-plus , DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and GPT-5.6 Luna) each silently selected a single draft in 20 of 20 cases, hiding the fact that the agent never converged; only GPT-6 Astra, at 64 times the cost, kept all drafts in 11 cases and selected in 3. A manual audit of 19 answers on which Astra and the default converter disagreed found Astra faithful in 18. Unfaithful conversion inflates the composite score by about 0.025 on average (0.09 on the five hardest answers) relative to faithful conversion. Eleven further converters tested on the five hardest answers against 23 manually established checkpoints did no better than 13 of 23, against 7–9 for the default. The root cause is that the official conversion prompt states no rules and its examples demonstrate rewriting; appending a short rule list to the prompt brings GPT-5.6 Terra to 23 of 23 and the default converter to 20 of 23. We reported the issue and the fix upstream. All numbers in this paper use the default converter, whose repeat agreement with itself is 93.5% at the default temperature (96.8% at temperature 0), so every cell is converted the same way; because the bias depends on the multi-draft rate, which differs across configurations (Appendix F ), we report that rate and read differences near 0.025 with care.
paragraphs.zh: DeepPlanning 只有在 LLM 将智能体的自由文本计划转换为结构化形式之后，才会对计划进行评分。 我们审查了这一步骤，因为我们的智能体常常在一次回答中提交多个计划草案（在 9B 关闭框架的回答中占 25.0%，包括 188 个被评分的回答；在 4B 关闭框架中则占 1.0%）。 在 20 个此类多草案回答中，四个转换器（默认 qwen-plus、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 和 GPT-5.6 Luna）在全部 20 个案例中均静默地选择了单个草案，掩盖了智能体从未收敛的事实；只有价格高出 64 倍的 GPT-6 Astra 在 11 个案例中保留了所有草案，并在其中 3 个案例中进行了选择。 对 19 个 Astra 和默认转换器结果不一致的回答进行人工审查后发现，Astra 在 18 个案例中的转换是忠实的。 不忠实的转换与忠实转换相比，会使综合得分平均虚增约 0.025（在最难的五个回答中为 0.09）。 另外测试的十一个转换器，在五个最难的回答上对照 23 个手动建立的检查点时，表现未超过 23 个中的 13 个，而默认转换器的表现则为 7–9 个。 根本原因在于官方转换提示词未说明任何规则，且其示例展示了改写行为；在提示词后附加一份简短的规则列表，可使 GPT-5.6 Terra 达到 23 个中的 23 个，默认转换器则达到 20 个中的 23 个。 我们已向上游报告了该问题及修复方法。 本文中的所有数字均使用默认转换器，其在默认温度下与自身的重复一致性为 93.5%（在温度为 0 时为 96.8%），因此每个单元格的转换方式都相同；由于偏差取决于多草案率，而该率在不同配置中有所差异（附录 F），因此我们报告了该比率，并谨慎地解读接近 0.025 的差异。

paragraphs.en: A co-author ran Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3 as the acting agent on DeepPlanning on a separate machine, four rollouts per cell on the 48 development and 72 held-out tasks, without and with an evolved harness from this paper’s lines (Table 15 ). Kimi K3 gains +0.058 (development) and +0.049 (held-out); Equation 2 on the development means puts 0.010 of it on delivery (96.9% to 99.3%) and 0.048 on the quality among delivered plans (0.431 to 0.479), the shape of the 9B line, and mean steps fall by more than half (19.7 to 8.4 and 23.3 to 10.1), the signature of removed loops. GLM 5.3 reaches 0.512 / 0.488 under the evolved harness; without a bare control its harness gain is not identified, and its 0.036 / 0.037 margin over Kimi is a difference between models, not a gain. Per-run readings, run identifiers, serving settings and the mapping to a versioned harness checkpoint are not in the repository at the time of writing and will be released with the code; these cells are therefore not same-night matched with any other cell, carry no noise estimate of their own, and their failure labels come from an earlier labelling scheme and are not pooled with Section 3.1 . They are an aggregate check of harness transfer, not evolution lines, and are not counted among the nine lines of Section 5.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 一位合著者在另一台机器上运行了 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.3，将其作为 DeepPlanning 中的代理智能体；在 48 个开发任务和 72 个预留任务中，每个单元格执行了四次推理，且未使用以及使用了本文代码行（表 15）中的演化封装器。 Kimi K3 的增益为 +0.058（开发集）和 +0.049（预留集）；开发集上的方程 2 表明，其中 0.010 体现在交付结果上（从 96.9% 提升至 99.3%），0.048 体现在已交付计划的品质上（从 0.431 提升至 0.479），呈现出 9B 模型线的形态，而平均步数则下降超过一半（从 19.7 降至 8.4，以及从 23.3 降至 10.1），这是循环被移除的典型特征。 在演化封装器下，GLM 5.3 的得分达到 0.512 / 0.488；若仅使用基础控制模型，其封装器的增益无法确定，而它相对于 Kimi 的 0.036 / 0.037 优势是模型间的差异，而非实际增益。 在撰写本文时，每次运行的读数、运行标识符、服务设置以及与版本化封装器检查点的映射关系均未包含在代码库中，并将随代码一同发布；因此，这些单元格未与任何其他单元格在同一晚进行匹配，也没有自身的噪声估计值，其失败标签来自早期的标注方案，且未与第 3.1 节合并。 它们是对封装器迁移的综合检验，而非演化路线的检验，因此不计入第 5.4 节中列出的九条路线。
